text: Then he washed in a river: from his left eye came Amaterasu, the sun goddess and ancestor of the four brothers, from his right the moon god, and from his nose Susanoo, god of storms.
spoken: Then he washed in a river: from his left eye came Ahmahtehrahsoo, the sun goddess and ancestor of the four brothers, from his right the moon god, and from his nose Soosahnooh, god of storms.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, po nazwie, długie słowo (5 syl.)

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
